conventionalCommit: chore: Renovate with the shared preset instead of Dependabot
intent: Dependency updates should arrive without manual merging, but only after a waiting time against supply-chain attacks. Major updates still need a person.
keyDecisions: Renovate with the owner's preset, over Dependabot with a cooldown
a minimum release age of 3 days with internalChecksFilter strict, so a branch appears only after the wait
automerge for non-major updates, majors as a pull request to merge by hand
trigger: "Merge dependabot nach drei Tagen deps (supply chain attack retention)" … "Moooment, hatten wir nicht auf renovate umgestellt?" … "Ja. Passen den preset an, dass ein automerge mit drei Tage grace period läuft. Manuell zu mergender PR nur bei major version update"

docs.message:
chore: Renovate with the shared preset instead of Dependabot

## Intent

Dependency updates should arrive without manual merging, but only after a waiting time against supply-chain attacks. Major updates still need a person.

## Key changes

- renovate.json extends github>mrsimpson/renovate-config.
- dependabot.yml is gone, and the workflow comments name Renovate.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The same change in apps (5ab90ae), lernapps.github.io (60c9dfc), tooling (6cb0e0d), app-templates (5b17e90).
- The waiting time and the automerge live in the owner's preset github>mrsimpson/renovate-config.
